title: The effects of heat treatment on the mechanical properties of cold-sprayed coatings

preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Material_Name: alloy cylinder with 100 mm of both outer diameter and length

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: fracture occurred between the interfaces of particles. No dimple can be observed according to the fractography. It seems that de-cohesive rupture occurred to the as-sprayed Al coating since its cohesion of particles is quite poor without heat treatment
